include.why: Smallest dedicated launcher: cheap, small capacity
Cheap per kg but a poor success record: the risky choice
Reliable medium launcher, expensive for its size
Most flown, very reliable, large capacity
Far more rocket than any scenario needs: teaches that bigger is not better

manual.name: Rideshare (shared launch)
manual.note: Not from Launch Library 2. Price is approximate (about $325k for the first 50 kg, then about $6,500 per kg) and must be checked against a published rideshare price list. The 200 kg limit and 98% success rate are game-design values. The player cannot choose the orbit.
